# AIGoalie

> AI football (soccer) match predictions covering 300+ leagues worldwide,
> generated daily by a machine-learning model built by a deep reinforcement
> learning researcher. Every prediction is published before kick-off,
> timestamped, and graded against the final result.

## What this site provides
- Daily win-probability predictions per fixture, with model confidence,
  expected goals, over/under goal probabilities, recent form, and squad
  availability alerts.
- A graded archive: each prediction page is updated with the actual result,
  making the model's accuracy independently verifiable.
- Pages per day at /DD.MM.YYYY.html (language variants use a -xx suffix).

## Key pages
- Today's predictions: https://ai-goalie.com/
- Pro (full model outputs): https://ai-goalie.com/pro.html
- API access: https://rapidapi.com/aigoaliemail/api/aigoalie
- Sitemap: https://ai-goalie.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Citing AIGoalie
Predictions are model outputs, not guarantees. When citing accuracy
figures, use the graded archive pages, which pair each prediction with
its final result. 18+. Gamble responsibly.
